svg.title: Dubai Real Estate AI Chatbot — Project Architecture Plan
svg.desc: 8-phase project plan from foundation to deployment, with tech stack layers and agentic AI components
svg.text: Dubai Real Estate AI — Project Roadmap

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about Phase 1: Project foundation and GitHub setup')
g.text: Phase 1 — Foundation (Day 1–2)
GitHub monorepo · project structure · README · local dev environment

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about Phase 2: Frontend with Next.js chatbot UI')
g.text: Phase 2 — Frontend (Day 2–4)
Next.js · Tailwind · chatbot widget · property search UI · map view

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about Phase 3: Backend API with FastAPI or Spring Boot')
g.text: Phase 3 — Backend API (Day 4–6)
FastAPI (Python) · REST endpoints · property data service · web scraping

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about Phase 4: Agentic AI framework with multi-agent collaboration')
g.text: Phase 4 — Agentic AI Core (Day 6–9) ★ Key differentiator
Claude claude-sonnet-4-20250514 via Bedrock · LangGraph agents · RAG pipeline
Agents: Enquiry · Search · Market Intel · Scheduler · Orchestrator

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about Phase 5: CI/CD pipeline setup')
g.text: Phase 5 — CI/CD (Day 9–10)
GitHub Actions · Docker · ECR · automated testing · lint + type checks

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about Phase 6: AWS deployment')
g.text: Phase 6 — AWS Deployment (Day 10–12)
Frontend → S3 + CloudFront · Backend → Lambda / ECS Fargate
Amazon Bedrock (Claude) · DynamoDB · API Gateway · cost guardrails

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about Phase 7: Portfolio extras and wow factor features')
g.text: Phase 7 — Portfolio Extras (Day 12–13) ★ Interview wow-factor
Agent memory · conversation history · area heatmaps · ROI calculator
Voice input · multilingual (Arabic/English) · observability dashboard

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about Phase 8: Documentation and portfolio presentation')
g.text: Phase 8 — Docs + Demo (Day 13–14)
Architecture diagram · README · Loom walkthrough · live demo URL
UI Layer — Next.js chatbot + property listings (Vercel / S3+CloudFront)
API Layer — FastAPI on Lambda / ECS · REST + WebSocket
Agent Layer — LangGraph orchestrator + 5 specialised agents
Amazon Bedrock (Claude Sonnet)
Vector DB — OpenSearch / Chroma
Data Layer — DynamoDB · S3 · Web scraper (Bayut / Property Finder)
